about.metaDescription: Scandinavian-Mediterranean home decor, chosen piece by piece by Yosra and Sergio.
about.title: About us
about.tagline: The balance between vision and design.
about.intro: B&C: Concept was born from real life, not from an office. We are Yosra and Sergio, and we believe that creating a home that feels like yours shouldn't be exhausting.
about.curationBody: Yosra chooses every piece with a clear standard of quality and fair price. We prefer a short, considered collection to an endless catalogue.
about.aestheticBody: We draw on Scandinavian design and Mediterranean light: honest materials, warm tones and pieces that accompany a space without imposing on it.
about.europeBody: We only select pieces that ship from warehouses located in the European Union.
about.closing: Sergio builds the shop so that buying feels as simple and calm as the pieces we choose. Together we bring criteria and design together, so you can find your style without searching everywhere.
